literal: Ancient lineage and honor and, will destroy altogether, poverty called craving.
translation: The craving called poverty will completely destroy both one's ancient lineage and honor.
modern: வறுமை என்று சொல்லப்படும் ஆசையானது, ஒருவருடைய பழமையான குடிப் பெருமையையும் அவருடைய மானத்தையும் ஒட்டுமொத்தமாக அழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: The couplet states that poverty is essentially a state of constant craving or desire. This relentless longing completely destroys a person's noble ancestry and their personal honor. The word 'தோல்' literally means skin, but here it is chosen to represent one's outward dignity or honor. The word 'நசை' highlights that poverty is fundamentally an affliction of unfulfilled desire. Together, poverty strips away everything that gives a person their social standing and self-respect.
